successor.exactInsertedBranch:
-- A genuine ordinary refund also carries the canonical database-TX timestamp.
  -- This branch grants no refund authority and cannot change cash/origin identity.
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.updated_at=now()
   AND(before_row-ARRAY['refunded_minor','failure_code','failure_message','updated_at'])=(after_row-ARRAY['refunded_minor','failure_code','failure_message','updated_at']) THEN RETURN NEW;END IF;

scope: Retain old early return byteexact. Extra branch requires exact database transaction timestamp and whole OLD/NEW equality except the same three preexisting mutable refund/failure fields plus updated_at. Every status, principal, provider, invoice, route, request and receipt field remains equal. No old application proof, historical bank observation or batch is reused as new authority. All original refund/counter guards, full shape/stage and ready pins remain byteexact.
